```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
```

## Download Albums

We fetch the release groups for Pink Floyd and Stone Temple Pilots via the MusicBrainz API, filtering for studio albums.

```{r}
#| label: download-albums

fetch_albums <- function(artist_id, artist_name) {
  Sys.sleep(1.5)
  url <- paste0(
    "https://musicbrainz.org/ws/2/release-group?artist=",
    artist_id,
    "&inc=ratings&limit=100&fmt=json"
  )
  
  res <- request(url) |>
    req_headers("User-Agent" = "CourseProject/1.0 (student@example.edu)") |>
    req_throttle(rate = 0.5) |>
    req_retry(
      max_tries = 5,
      is_transient = \(resp) resp_status(resp) %in% c(429, 503),
      after = \(resp) 3
    ) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json()
  
  rgs <- res[["release-groups"]]
  
  tibble(
    id = map_chr(rgs, "id"),
    artist = artist_name,
    title = map_chr(rgs, "title"),
    primary_type = map_chr(rgs, \(x) x[["primary-type"]] %||% NA_character_),
    secondary_types = map_chr(rgs, \(x) paste(x[["secondary-types"]], collapse = ", ")),
    release_date = map_chr(rgs, \(x) x[["first-release-date"]] %||% NA_character_),
    rating = map_dbl(rgs, \(x) as.numeric(x[["rating"]][["value"]] %||% NA_real_)),
    votes = map_int(rgs, \(x) as.integer(x[["rating"]][["votes-count"]] %||% 0L))
  ) |>
    filter(primary_type == "Album", secondary_types == "") |>
    mutate(cover_url = paste0("https://coverartarchive.org/release-group/", id, "/front-250")) |>
    select(artist, title, release_date, rating, votes, cover_url)
}

if (file.exists("albums.csv") && nrow(read_csv("albums.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) > 0) {
  albums <- read_csv("albums.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  artists <- tribble(
    ~artist, ~id,
    "Pink Floyd", "83d91898-7763-47d7-b03b-b92132375c47",
    "Stone Temple Pilots", "8c32bb01-58a3-453b-8050-8c0620edb0e5"
  )

  albums <- map2(artists$id, artists$artist, fetch_albums) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    arrange(artist, release_date)

  write_csv(albums, "albums.csv")
}
```

## Album Covers

Hover your cursor over any vinyl cover to view album information.

```{r}
#| label: display-gallery
#| results: asis

cards <- glue::glue(
  '<div class="album-card">',
  '<img src="{albums$cover_url}" alt="{albums$title}" class="album-cover" loading="lazy" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src=\'https://placehold.co/250x250/222/fff?text=Cover+Unavailable\';" />',
  '<div class="album-popup">',
  '<div class="popup-title">{albums$title}</div>',
  '<div class="popup-artist">{albums$artist}</div>',
  '<span class="popup-date">Released: {albums$release_date}</span>',
  '</div>',
  '</div>'
)

cat(paste0('<div class="album-gallery">\n', paste(cards, collapse = "\n"), '\n</div>\n'))
```
